front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, your number out of 25 and the two brands, set inside a Hyperliquid shape written in the HYPE genesis record.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name, etched and filled in Hyperliquid mint.

front.label: Brands
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the official wordmarks in white.

front.label: Genesis fill
front.desc: The Hyperliquid shape is written in the HYPE genesis record: Hyperliquid India ENS, date, time, unix, token ID, max supply, airdrop and wallets.

front.label: Namehash
front.desc: Your name's onchain ID, the ENS namehash, runs in mint through the name. No two cards share it.

back.label: Back
back.desc: The HYPE genesis record, the token, and the holder this card was made for.

back.label: Genesis record
back.desc: Date, unix time, token address, supply, distribution and wallets of the HYPE genesis.

back.label: Holder
back.desc: Your name and the namehash of the name this card belongs to.

back.label: QR
back.desc: Scan or tap to open the card page and verify the holder onchain.
